grammatical_complexity.notes: Dominated by present simple in dialogue. Present perfect and past simple appear a few times. One first conditional in the grace prayer. Relative clauses are basic. Complex structures are rare, appearing in 1-2 instances at most.

Day of the Dead (familiar to learner)
cultural_reference_load.notes: The entire plot revolves around experiencing an American Thanksgiving for the first time. Many specific food items and customs (grace, clockwise passing, football during dinner) require cultural knowledge. The plot is followable but much of the detail would be lost without understanding Thanksgiving culture.

sentence_structure.notes: Dialogue format with mostly short, simple sentences. Some moderate compound sentences with conjunctions. Occasional longer explanatory sentences about food. No complex multi-clause structures.
